content: Hi how can i assist you today
Printers at work list job names similar to words I’m thinking, even from other people’s computers.
Queue names reflect document titles users chose. Are the similar words common project terms or filenames in your team?
Yes, terms from the current campaign.
Campaign vocabulary tends to repeat across drafts. If you scan filenames in the shared folder, you may see the same words driving the queue entries.
Shared folder has lots of files with those terms.
That would account for the queue similarities. A screenshot of the folder list versus the printer queue shows the overlap clearly.
I’ll compare them after the next print run.
